🚀 Getting Started with AWS? Here's What You Need to Know! ☁️
If you're preparing for cloud interviews and just diving into Amazon Web Services (AWS), start with the basics that interviewers love to ask:
🔸 What is AWS?
🔸 Core Services: EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda
🔸 IAM Roles & Permissions
🔸 VPC, Subnets, and Networking Basics
🔸 Cost Management & Free Tier
🔸 Hands-on practice using AWS Console
🧠 Pro Tip: Focus on real-world use cases and basic architecture diagrams — they leave a strong impression in interviews!
🎯 Stay consistent, build small projects, and keep learning.
#AWS #CloudComputing #Beginners #AWSforBeginners #InterviewPreparation #TechCareers #LearnCloud #CloudJourney #AWSInterview
AWS Basics

ai_analysis.summary: This introductory post gives beginners an AWS interview-preparation checklist. It identifies Amazon Web Services (AWS), four core services—EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda—and basic topics covering IAM roles and permissions, VPCs, subnets, networking, cost management, and the Free Tier. It recommends hands-on practice in the AWS Console, real-world use cases, basic architecture diagrams, consistent learning, and small projects. It does not explain the functions of the listed services or provide detailed technical guidance.
